categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Baosi Energy Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in four main business segments: screw compressors, vacuum pumps, hydraulic pumps, and high-efficiency precision cutting tools. The company focuses on the research, design, production, and sales of high-end precision mechanical components and complete sets of equipment, serving various industrial sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including high-precision machining with imported German KAPP grinding machines for rotors, optimized structural designs for energy efficiency, and specialized coatings using nanotechnology to enhance product durability. Production methods combine stock production for standard parts and custom order production for non-standard components, supported by a 6S-based manufacturing management system to ensure quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include enterprises in machinery manufacturing, petrochemical, textile, food processing, pharmaceuticals, electronics, automotive, power generation, mining, and emerging industries such as photovoltaics, lithium batteries, and semiconductors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a significant portion of sales concentrated in East China and expanding overseas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Ningbo, Jiangxi, and Chongqing. Sales are primarily concentrated in East China, South China, North China, Central China, Northwest China, Northeast China, Southwest China, and overseas markets. The overseas business accounts for a smaller but growing share of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Baosi Energy Equipment operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and assembly of precision mechanical components and complete equipment sets such as compressors, pumps, and cutting tools. It sources raw materials and components from suppliers and sells finished products directly to industrial customers or through distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in energy-saving and environmentally friendly technologies, aiming for import substitution and high-quality manufacturing. R&D priorities include developing advanced screw compressor hosts, dry vacuum pumps for emerging industries, servo energy-saving hydraulic systems, and specialized cutting tools. The company invests significantly in R&D, maintains a strong patent portfolio, and collaborates with research institutions to enhance technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of compressors, vacuum pumps, hydraulic pumps, and cutting tools. The company employs a mixed sales model with direct sales dominating for most products and distributor sales primarily for complete compressor units. Additional income comes from investment gains, government subsidies, and after-sales services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ningbo Baosi is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the fluid machinery industry, recognized for its advanced screw compressor technology and awarded national manufacturing champion products. It competes with both international brands and domestic peers, focusing on technological innovation, product quality, and cost leadership to strengthen its market position amid intense competition and product homogenization.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.32 billion, a slight decrease of 3.9% year-over-year, while net profit attributable to shareholders surged by 196.58% to RMB 832 million, partly due to gains from divestitures. Total assets stood at RMB 3.54 billion with net assets of RMB 2.5 billion, reflecting a solid growth trajectory and enhanced profitability despite some revenue pressure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes energy-saving, environmental protection, and import substitution as its core product positioning, aligning with national strategic priorities. Its products feature high precision, reliability, and efficiency, supported by advanced manufacturing capabilities and comprehensive quality control. The company also offers tailored solutions and strong after-sales service, aiming to deliver superior value and foster long-term customer trust.
